headline: Adopted consent agenda and approved liquor license renewals and new license for Sherpa Kitchen
summary: The commission adopted the consent agenda, which included 2026-2027 First and Third Liquor License and Outside Consumption Permit renewals. It also approved a First Class Liquor License Application for Sherpa Kitchen at 119 College Street for 2026-2027.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including 2026-2027 First and Third Liquor License and Outside Consumption Permit Renewals.
Approved the 2026-2027 First Class Liquor License Application for Sherpa Kitchen, 119 College Street.
